people.imagined: In the horse lines at dusk he is brushing down a mare and speaks to a young blade about debts, his head tilted a little to the right to keep the ruined left ear out of sight.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a horse line, he leans his forearm on a mare's neck and tilts his head to the right as he speaks, hiding his damaged ear without quite managing it. Face (most important: the frost-ruined ear): a long, lean, weathered face; his LEFT ear is half gone, the top half a jagged, shrivelled stump of pink scar tissue, clearly visible on the near side; steady, patient hazel eyes; grey bushy brows; a long nose with a split vein; a calm, slightly crooked mouth; a short grey moustache. Hair: grey, long, tied in a horsetail low at the nape, with the ear showing. Body: lean, tall, slightly bowed from long years in the saddle. His shoulders are broad and his hands big and cracked from rein and brush. Clothing: a thick brown-and-grey felt riding coat with a high leather-edged collar and a wide belt, clean and brushed; a red wool band on the upper arm; a dust scarf at his neck; a jade-green night-glow cup on a cord at the hip. Hands and objects: a horse brush in the right hand, resting on the mare's neck; a bay mare with a rope halter. Background: blurred long rope line of horses in warm dusk, felt tents. A thread of cook-fire smoke climbs beside him. Light: low amber sunset from the upper left, a faint ember hint of fire qi at his hands. Expression: a slow, patient half-smile and steady hazel eyes, the settled calm of an old rider who has already forgiven the world.

people.imagined: Pouring a night-glowing cup for the young blades at the fire, her thumb and finger straining at the cup-shaped scar where her grandfather's jade cup split. She watches who drinks.
people.subject: The moment: at a night fire she tilts a green jade ewer to pour into a cup held out to the viewer, with a proud, cold, level stare. Face: a sharp, handsome, arrogant face; high cheekbones; narrow black eyes; thin high-arched brows; a straight nose; a thin red mouth with the corners lifted; a faint rider's tan. Hair: black, tied in a high topknot with a red cord and a bone pin. Body: tall, long-limbed, shoulders squared. Clothing: a fine brown-and-grey felt riding coat with a high leather-edged collar and a red wool band on the upper arm, clean and well fitted; red tassel at the shoulder; baggy trousers into tall boots; a sabre on the belt. Hands and objects (the scar must read): between her right thumb and forefinger, a pale, cup-shaped crescent scar like a half-moon, plainly visible against her tan as she grips the ewer; in the other hand, a night-glowing jade cup, pale green, glowing faintly from within. Background: blurred orange campfire, dark felt tents, sparks. Light: orange firelight from below left and the green glow of the cup under her chin; a faint ember red fire qi at her eyes. Expression: arrogant, brave, vengeful, watching who will dare drink.

people.imagined: Riding at dawn on the Hồi Lan road, she turns in her saddle and waves a hand at the rider one dune behind, laughing, the bell in her braid jingling.
people.subject: The moment: on a camel at dawn she twists round in the saddle and waves over her shoulder with a wide, friendly grin, a brass bell jangling in her braid. Face: a round, sun-browned, cheerful face; bright dark brown eyes crinkled with laughter; soft level brows; a button nose; a big warm mouth. A scatter of freckles crosses her nose and the sun has reddened the tops of her cheeks. Hair: black, in one long braid over the shoulder with a small round brass camel bell tied into it, plainly visible and hanging by her cheek. Body: sturdy and strong, a rider's easy seat. Clothing: a brown-and-grey felt riding coat with a leather-edged collar, clean, over baggy trousers into riding boots; a dust scarf of faded blue at her neck; a pale glass night-glow cup on a cord at her hip; a short curved sabre on the belt. Hands and objects: her right hand waving, her left holding the camel's rope rein; behind her, a woolly saddlebag with a bundle of cloth. Background: blurred pale sand dunes with a small distant rider on the ridge, a pink dawn sky. The camel's shaggy neck and one tufted ear rise at the lower edge of the frame, with a long shadow of the rider stretched across the sand. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left, a faint ember hint of fire qi. Expression: a wide, honest, laughing grin with crinkled eyes, the face of a girl who has never met a stranger she did not want to wave at.

people.imagined: In the stable at dusk he leans his forehead against the grey mare's face while she nuzzles his shoulder. No one else has ever looked at him with that much approval.
people.subject: The moment: in a stable, a plain young man rests his cheek on the neck of a grey mare who nuzzles his shoulder, his eyes closed in contentment. Face: a long, plain, unremarkable face, narrow, with a long jaw and a big nose; mild brown eyes; thin straight brows; a wide, gentle mouth with a slight smile; sunburnt. His ears are large and slightly flushed, and a few straw-coloured stubble hairs show along the long jaw. Hair: brown, short, straw stuck in it. Body: lanky and loose-limbed, long arms. Clothing: a plain brown felt riding coat with a leather-edged collar, clean but unadorned, no red band; a dust scarf of grey wool; sleeves rolled. The boots are plain, worn down at the heels but oiled, and a strip of grey wool is tied round his left wrist. Hands and objects: one hand strokes the mare's nose; the other holds a currycomb; a night-glow cup of pale glass hangs on a cord at his belt. The mare is a handsome silver-grey with a dark mane, with a red bridle tassel. Background: blurred stable stall, hay, a lantern. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, a faint earth-ochre qi hint. A thin shaft of dusty light falls across the mare's silver neck and his cheek. Expression: content, peaceable, loyal; at ease with the only one who admires him.

people.imagined: On a night ride, he holds a rope taut across the road, fist clenched, the black veins on the back of his hand standing out, and watches a driver stumble with no expression.
people.subject: The moment: at night he stands with a thick rope wrapped round his right fist, the back of that hand clearly visible and marked with black branching veins climbing from the wrist to the knuckles, and looks flatly past the viewer. Face: a hard, handsome, narrow young face; flat black eyes with no light in them; straight dark brows; a thin nose; a thin mouth with no expression. A thin pale scar runs through his left brow and a muscle stands in his jaw. Hair: black, in a tight high tail with a red cord. Body: lean and tall, rigid. Clothing: a dark brown felt riding coat with a high leather-edged collar, clean and fine, a red cord tassel at the shoulder; a dust scarf; tall boots; a black curved sabre on the belt; a green glass night-glow cup on a cord. Hands and objects: the black-veined right hand clenched on the rope; the left on the sabre grip. Background: blurred night road, a faint caravan lantern. A line of dark wagon shapes and the small gold flame of a lantern recede into the night behind him. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left and a thin orange rim from the fire at right; a faint dark-red fire qi at the veins. Expression: a flat, lightless stare and a mouth held perfectly still, the hard calm of someone who feels nothing about what he is watching.

people.imagined: At a raiders' fire, welcomed loudly, she sits stiffly with her cut-down blue sash tied tight round her wrist and her eyes on the one deserter she does not trust.
people.subject: The moment: at a campfire she sits upright with arms folded and eyes sliding sideways toward someone off to the left, a strip of blue cloth tightly tied round her right wrist. Face: a narrow, pale, sharp young face; wary dark eyes; strong thin brows; a thin straight nose; a tight mouth. A thin line of dark kohl runs along each lower lid, newly applied to look like the riders she joined. Hair: black, short, cropped, with a loose strand. Body: slender, wiry, rigid. Clothing: a brown felt riding coat with a leather-edged collar, new and clean, a red band on the sleeve; a dust scarf; boots; a short sabre on the belt. Her new coat still has crisp fold lines from the bale and its red band is a shade too bright against the weathered felts around her. Hands and objects: the blue guard's sash cut down and knotted tight round her wrist as a plain wristband, clearly visible against the brown sleeve; a pale glass night-glow cup in her other hand, untouched; a small folded slip of paper in her sleeve cuff. Background: blurred loud camp, riders' backs, a fire. Behind her a rider throws back his head in a laugh, a tilted jug at his lips, though she does not turn. Light: orange firelight from the lower right, cold blue edge light from upper left; a faint blue-grey metal qi hint. Expression: ambitious, paranoid, faithless; welcome and alone.

people.imagined: In a glass-blower's hut with a fresh cup glowing on the pipe's end, she tips her hand into her pocket and rolls a few glass beads, glancing up to check no one has seen.
people.subject: The moment: in a small hut she holds a blow-pipe with a bulb of glowing glass at its end in one hand while the other dips into her pocket, thumb moving over glass beads, her eyes sliding up warily. Face: a round, shrewd, flushed face; small bright dark eyes; thin arched brows; a short nose; a pursed mouth; sweat on the cheeks. Hair: dark brown, in a thick bun under a leather band, with a loose strand stuck to the forehead. Body: stout, short, strong forearms. Clothing: a leather glassworker's apron over a brown felt coat with the sleeves rolled; a red wool cord round the upper arm; a dust scarf wet at the neck; leather gloves tucked in her belt. Hands and objects: a long iron blowpipe with an orange-glowing glass bulb; in her pocket the pale glint of beads; shelves of finished glass cups with a faint green glow behind her. A few round glass beads show between her thumb and forefinger, each a small blue or amber spark. Background: blurred glass furnace with a bright orange mouth. The furnace mouth glows like a small sun, with the shimmer of heat bending the air above it. Light: bright orange furnace light from the lower left, with green glow of finished cups; a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: a pursed, narrow-eyed look of quick calculation, the mouth tight and the glance sliding up from her pocket like a woman counting what she has just kept.

people.imagined: In his tent at night with his jade cup glowing on his belt, he has just heard that the road is quiet. He is thinking of the son who is far away and has gone very still, hand on the cup.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a low stool in a tent at night, a huge old rider grips his glowing jade cup in his big right hand and stares out at the viewer under heavy brows. Face (most important: the burn): a vast, heavy, weathered face; a great burn scar covers the left side from cheekbone to jaw, glossy, shiny, pink and white and puckered; a thick grey beard to the chest; one fierce black eye and one that droops from the scar; thick white eyebrows; a broad broken nose; a hard, downturned mouth. Hair: grey, long, loose, tied back with a leather thong. Body: huge, broad-shouldered, immensely thick, seated square. Clothing: a heavy brown-and-grey felt riding coat with a high fur-edged collar, fine, clean and old; a thick red wool band on the upper arm; a wide belt of black leather; on the belt, a black curved sabre in a plain sheath; a small silver tally on a cord at his neck. Hands and objects: a thin pale green jade cup glowing in the dark in his right hand, lighting his beard from below; the left on his knee. Background: blurred tent wall with hanging bridles, dark. Light: green glow of the cup from below, warm brazier light from the upper left; ember red fire qi hint. Expression: warlike, wrathful, greedy, and very, very tired.

people.imagined: On the Đà Linh road at midday, she smiles at an envoy of the Pavilion with her feathered sabre at her hip. She is working out the toll. The envoy is not comfortable.
people.subject: The moment: at a roadside halt she gives a slow, thin, friendly smile to the viewer, her head tilted a little and one hand toying with a hawk feather on her sabre's pommel. Face: a lean, hard, handsome desert face; sharp cheekbones; long dark amber eyes with a glitter; thin arched brows; a long straight nose; a thin red-lipped smile just a little too wide, which is the mark of her; a small scar at the left lip. Hair: black, tied in a long tail under a red felt cap. Body: lean, tall, tough, loose-hipped, rider's stance. Clothing: a coat of thick RED-dyed felt with a high leather-edged collar, layered over a glint of mail at the chest, fine and clean; a red band on the upper arm; a tight black belt. Hands and objects: a light red curved sabre at her hip with a brown-and-white hawk feather knotted to the pommel, the feather clearly visible and large; a ring on her right hand with a small live ember glowing red in the bezel. Background: blurred sunlit road, a few small wagons waiting. Light: hot noon sun from the upper left, an ember-red glow at the ring; strong fire qi hint. Expression: cruel, greedy, ambitious; a smile that sells the road back to you.

people.imagined: At the fire with her young blades around her, pouring wine with a smile like her mother's and a height like her father's. She toasts, the cup sewn on her breast glowing, and she counts who is following.
people.subject: The moment: standing tall at a fire she raises a glowing green glass cup in a toast toward the viewer with a wide, easy smile, as the crowd of young riders blurs behind her. Face: a tall, handsome, strong-boned young woman's face, golden-tan; wide warm dark eyes with a glint; thick arched brows; a straight nose; a wide, charming smile; a small scar through the right eyebrow. Hair: black, long, tied in a high tail with red cords and a few small silver rings. Body: very tall, broad-shouldered for a woman, long legs. Clothing: a riding coat of brown felt with a red cord edging and a high collar, finely cut; on the left breast, a small pale-green night-glowing cup shape sewn as an emblem, glowing faintly; a red band on the upper arm; a dust scarf of red silk loosely knotted. Hands and objects: the raised cup in her right hand, glowing; at her belt a curved sabre; the left hand open, beckoning. Background: blurred orange fire, many young faces with wrapped cloth masks. Light: warm firelight from the lower left, green glow on her chin; strong ember fire qi hint. Expression: ambitious, gregarious, deceitful; a charm that counts heads.

people.imagined: At the Đà Linh well, posting a leg on the board with a neat hand, the small traders gathering. He is proud of his ledger and does not know that someone has read it.
people.subject: The moment: at a well-side board he stands upright in the sun, pinning up a small plain paper with a tidy hand while his keen eyes glance sideways at the viewer. Face: a weathered, tidy, clean-shaven face; calm, clever brown eyes with crow's-feet; level thin brows; a straight nose; a firm, mild mouth with a faint satisfied curve; a neat trimmed grey-flecked moustache. Fine sun-lines fan out from the corners of his eyes. Hair: black with grey at the temples, combed back and tied in a tidy knot. Body: medium height, compact, straight-backed, neat. Clothing: a brown-and-grey felt riding coat, immaculate, buttoned neat at the high collar; a red band on the upper arm; a dust scarf of blue cotton neatly folded; a wide belt. Hands and objects: a small blank paper slip and a brass pin in the right hand; a thick leather ledger with a brass clasp tucked under the left arm (cover plain, no writing); a short sabre at the belt. Background: blurred well-head with a wooden board hung with small slips, small traders in a cluster, camels. Dry earth, a stone well-curb with a rope coil, and a hanging row of small pinned slips lit by the sun. Light: bright midday sun from the upper left, a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: a mild, firm, faintly satisfied half-smile with level eyes, the face of a man who likes to be paid and likes the paperwork of it even more.

people.imagined: At a night camp, he sits wiping his sabre with a rag. He has stopped scrubbing the black from his knuckles. He is told it is strength, and he is looking at the viewer as if for approval.
people.subject: The moment: at a night camp he sits with a naked sabre across his knees, wiping its blade with a cloth, glancing up with an eager, hungry look. Face: a long, gaunt, hollow-cheeked young face; sunken dark eyes; thin brows; a sharp nose; a thin cruel mouth in a small smile; pale skin. Dark shadows lie under his eyes and his lower lip is bitten raw. Hair: black, short, matted at the neck. Body: lean, wiry, slouching. Clothing: a dark brown felt riding coat with a high leather-edged collar, clean, a red cord at the shoulder; a dust scarf; baggy trousers and boots. Hands and objects (the stain must read): the knuckles of his right hand are stained with solid black marks, clearly dark smudges across all four knuckles, that he no longer scrubs; the sabre in his lap is dark and wet-looking with a thin red line of fire qi along the edge; a pale glass cup at his belt. Background: blurred dark tents, a low red fire. A single low tent flap stirs in the draught and sparks drift up from the red fire. Light: red firelight from the lower left, cold blue edge from the upper left; a dark-red fire qi hint at the blade. Expression: a thin, eager, hollow-eyed smile, brows pulled slightly up, hungry for a praise that is not there to give it.

people.imagined: At full gallop across the steppe, a little tilted in the saddle favouring the bad leg, riding faster so that nobody can see the limp. She laughs into the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at a gallop on a brown horse across a flat steppe, she leans low and laughs into the wind, her left leg held a little stiffly in the stirrup. Face: a thin, lively, windburnt face; bright, brave brown eyes narrowed against the wind; strong thin brows; a small nose; a big laughing mouth, teeth white. Hair: dark brown, in a long braid streaming behind her, a faded red ribbon whipped flat. Loose wisps escape and whip across her cheek, and the ribbon is faded to the colour of dried blood. Body: slim, wiry, a rider's crouch, one leg stiffer than the other. Her weight is shifted onto the right stirrup, the left knee turned slightly out, a small stiffness a careful eye would catch. Clothing: a brown felt riding coat, clean, with a leather-edged collar flapping open, a dust scarf streaming; baggy trousers; boots. Hands and objects: both hands on the reins of the galloping brown horse; a pale glass night-glow cup on a cord bouncing at the hip; a short sabre on the belt. Background: blurred yellow steppe and a huge pale sky, speed streaks. A second rider, tiny and distant, trails dust at the horizon line. Light: bright sun from the upper left, a faint ember hint of fire qi. Expression: brave, fickle, gregarious; hiding the pain by speed.

people.imagined: At a fire, he drinks from a green cup he won back, laughing before the joke arrives. His chipped front tooth shows. He is drunk on the memory of taking it back.
people.subject: The moment: at a fire he tips a green night-glowing cup to his lips with a loud, open laugh, head thrown back, chipped tooth in plain view. Face (most important: the chipped tooth): a thin, handsome, reckless young face; one upper front tooth chipped to a jagged half, clearly visible in his wide laughing mouth; bright dark eyes; thin brows; a long narrow nose; stubble on the chin. Hair: black, wild, falling over the forehead, with a red rag tied at the temple. A small chip of dried mud clings above one ear and a few sparks of ash dust his black hair. Body: lanky, loose-jointed, swaggering. He sits with one boot up on a log, elbow on his knee, the posture of a man holding the centre of the circle. Clothing: a brown felt riding coat open at the high collar, worn but clean, a red cord at the shoulder; dust scarf; a belt with a sabre. Hands and objects: a night-glow cup of pale green glass, glowing, tilted to the mouth; the other hand holds a pair of dice. Background: blurred fire, riders' shoulders, sparks. Light: warm orange firelight from the lower left, green glow of the cup lighting his jaw; a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: arrogant, vengeful, indulgent; laughing a beat early. Eyes bright and a little glassy, cheeks flushed with wine and triumph.

people.imagined: Asleep in the saddle on the escort road, face pressed into the saddle blanket, a woven pattern pressed into his cheek, camel plodding on. He has never seen a raid.
people.subject: The moment: dozing on a camel's back, his cheek squashed against the rolled saddle blanket, eyes shut, mouth a little open. Face (most important: the weave): a round, soft, sunburnt young face; a clear red crisscross pattern of the blanket weave pressed into his right cheek; closed eyes; thin brows; a flat nose; a slack open mouth; a trace of drool. A thread of drool glints at the corner of his mouth and the soft round cheeks are sunburnt pink across the nose. Hair: black, short and sticking up. His hair is flattened on one side where he has slept on it and stands up in a tuft on the other. Body: soft, stocky, slumped forward over the camel's hump. Clothing: a plain brown felt riding coat with a leather-edged collar, clean, no red band; a dust scarf pulled down; a night-glow cup of pale glass on a cord at his belt; a small sabre in a wrapped sheath. Hands and objects: one arm hangs loose; the other holds the camel's rope slackly; a woven striped saddle blanket. Background: blurred pale desert road, another camel plodding ahead. Ahead of him a dun-coloured camel's rump sways in a column of dust, a faint wavy heat haze above the road. Light: warm hazy afternoon sun from the upper left, a faint earth-ochre qi hint. Expression: honest, lazy, peaceable; thoroughly asleep.

people.imagined: Trimming his beard in a camp mirror with a small knife he swears was his father's. He catches the viewer in the mirror and holds the knife still, as if caught mid-lie.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in front of a small hand mirror, he trims a wedge of beard with a small knife and meets the viewer's eyes in the mirror with a slow, smooth smile. Face: a narrow, sly, handsome face; a neat, sharp WEDGE of black beard at the chin, trimmed to a point, the dominant feature; quick, watchful hazel eyes; thin arched brows; a straight nose; thin lips in a smooth smile. Hair: black, slicked back and oiled, tied at the nape. Two thin braids are twisted back from each temple and joined at the nape with a plain bone clip. Body: slim, a clever young man's poise, one shoulder forward. Clothing: a new brown felt riding coat with a leather-edged collar, too clean, no red band; a dust scarf of blue wool, the same blue as Trấn Sa's sash; a belt with a small sabre. Hands and objects: a small bone-handled knife in the right hand at the beard; a round bronze hand mirror in the left. Background: blurred tent interior, a lamp. Behind him a tent wall of dark felt, a stacked saddle and a hanging red cord. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, a faint blue-grey metal qi hint. The lamplight leaves the left half of his face in shadow so that only one watchful eye shows clearly in the mirror. Expression: deceitful, ambitious, paranoid; helpful, to a point.

people.imagined: Gazing at Hạng Lưu Hỏa from across the fire with shining eyes, her own small cup in her hands, one side of her hair singed short, ready for any order.
people.subject: The moment: at a fire she stares with shining devotion at someone off to the right, hugging a small glowing cup to her chest. Face: a small, round, bright young face, flushed; huge dark eyes shining with worship; thick straight brows; a small snub nose; a small open mouth. Her cheeks are smudged with ash and a small round burn scab shows beside the nose. Her lower lip is chapped and a faint freckling of soot spots her forehead. Hair (most important): black hair worn long, but the RIGHT side is singed short, jagged and uneven, a clear difference between the long left and the short burnt right, with a faint scorched ends. Body: small, slight, very young, upright. Clothing: a brown felt riding coat a little too large with sleeves rolled, a leather-edged collar; a red wool cord round the arm; a dust scarf; boots too big. The borrowed coat's hem hangs well below her knees and the boots, stuffed with wool at the toes, point slightly inward. Hands and objects: a small pale green glass night-glow cup held to the chest in both hands, glowing faintly under her chin. A scorched strand of her own hair is wound round one finger of the hand that holds the cup. Background: blurred fire and riders in silhouette. Behind her a long line of horsemen sit in shadow against a red-gold glow. Light: warm orange from the lower right, green cup-glow on the chin; a faint ember fire qi hint. Expression: wide, shining, unguarded devotion, brows drawn up in the middle and lips parted, a child ready to be given any order at all.

people.imagined: In the burning stockade, at her desk among the ledgers, taking up the lamp. She has chosen to stay. She looks up once, calm, before she tips the flame.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in a stockade room, an older woman looks up calmly with a lit lamp in her hand; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a gentle, strong, composed face with fine lines; large dark steady eyes; thin level brows; a straight nose; a small, firm, kind mouth. Hair: black with grey, in a smooth, low bun with two plain wooden pins. A single faded jade pin is set into the bun and a loose wisp has fallen beside her ear. Body: slim, upright, neat. She sits with a straight back, shoulders level, and the stillness of a woman who has already made her choice. Clothing: a plain, fine, well-pressed merchant's robe of dull plum cloth with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, a plain sash; no felt, no weapons. Hands and objects: a small brass lamp with a small flame in her right hand; her left rests on a thick pile of bound books (plain covers, no writing) on the desk. Background: faded brown wall, a window with dim orange light at the edge. Behind her the paper screens glow with a dull orange as fire creeps along the stockade wall, a brush and an ink-stone on the desk. Light: soft warm lamplight from the lower left. Expression: generous, cautious, loyal; calm resolve.

people.imagined: At the stockade gate, holding the line alone, a jade cup on his belt. He smiles toward the camp behind him, because his brother has gone through to kneel, and turns back to the dark.
people.subject: The moment: at a gate he looks back over his shoulder toward the viewer with a broad, easy, loyal smile, a curved sabre in his hand; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, rugged, big-featured face; thick black moustache and short beard flecked with grey; warm dark eyes with deep crow's-feet; thick brows; a broken nose; a wide, brave mouth. Hair: black-grey, long, bound with a red cloth. A few grey strands at the temples and a faded red cloth tied over a topknot, the ends fluttering. Body: tall, broad, thick-chested, a fighting man's stance. He stands with feet apart and his weight low, one shoulder turned toward the dark beyond the gate. Clothing: a heavy brown felt riding coat with a high fur collar, worn at the elbows but clean, a wide leather belt; a dust scarf; baggy trousers into boots. Hands and objects: a curved sabre in the right hand, point down; at the belt, a pale green jade cup glowing faintly. Background: faded dim gate posts and dark night. Light: low warm light from the upper left. Expression: loyal, brave, indulgent; at peace. A broad open smile, the creases at his eyes deep, as of a man who knows he has done what he came for.
